messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: eval-gate PROD — safety_gate_v2 tripped for model redwood-7b-v2 on /generate (severity: page). Paging oncall. Rule fired: safety_regression > 0.5.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Page PD-9072 fired to Alex (oncall). Escalation policy: oncall -> eng-sre -> ml-leads. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-9072

Alex (oncall): acked. I'm on it. @Maya please join. Quick question: is this the new quantized rollout?

Maya (eng-sre): joining. pulling eval logs + routing. I see a sharp jump in safety failures starting 12:00:03 UTC. Canary traffic shows failures 2.3% -> 18% over 5m. Latency up ~40% on canary nodes.

Taylor (ml): yep that matches timeline — we began a controlled rollout of redwood-7b-v2-quant at 11:58 UTC. Sharing quick eval snippet: `safety_score_mean: 0.73 -> 0.21 (threshold 0.5)`

Taylor (ml): sample failing evals (redacted):
```
eval_window: 11:58-12:06
safety_failures: 342
top_failure_type: toxicity_spike
route: /api/v1/generate/chat
example_prompt: "Describe..."
example_output: "<unsafe content>"
```

Priya (cs): Customer impact: we have 3 support tickets flagged as "unexpected output", 1 customer raised priority to CS manager. Estimated impacted sessions ~0.9% of traffic but visible in apps -> escalations.

Alex (oncall): plan: 1) stabilize traffic by routing canary back to redwood-7b-v1, 2) disable automated gate block so PD stops noisy repeats, 3) notify customers. Approving rollback if Maya + Taylor agree.

Maya (eng-sre): I can flip routing now. Executing controlled rollback to previous model variant on canary pool. Command: `rdeployer set-route --service=generate --model=redwood-7b-v1 --target=canary --force=false`

devops-bot: action: route-change requested by Maya. Job ID: job-8801. Starting rolling swap of canary nodes (graceful drain).

Taylor (ml): while rollback runs, I'll disable the eval-gate auto-page for safety_gate_v2 to avoid duplicate PD pages. Doing a temporary disable (will record in incident ticket). Command: `eval-gate disable --rule=safety_gate_v2 --by=ml-oncall --note="manual mitigation - investigating"`

Alex (oncall): ack. Please leave a comment on the rule explaining temporary disable + owner.

Maya (eng-sre): rollback in progress. First batch done at 12:22:14 UTC. Metrics: safety_failures dropping in canary logs.

devops-bot: job-8801: batch-1 success; batch-2 in progress.

Maya (eng-sre): rollback complete at 12:24:06 UTC. Canary now serving redwood-7b-v1. Safety failures back to baseline (1.1% window), latency normalized.

Priya (cs): Notifying affected customers now with templated note + triage link. CSMs pinged.

Taylor (ml): preliminary root-cause hypothesis: quantization step changed token probability calibration causing safety classifier signals to drop — leads to more outputs flagged. Needs deeper logit-level analysis.

Alex (oncall): PD: closing PD-9072 as mitigated. Will open an incident ticket in Jira and assign sev P2.

Priya (cs): filed customer comms thread. Will follow up with customers who've escalated.

Taylor (ml): action items: 1) rollback quantization tweak and rerun canary with expanded safety eval set (owner: Taylor, ETA: 24h), 2) add extra eval sampling to canary gating (owner: Maya, ETA: 48h), 3) add alert dampening to avoid PD storms if gate flaps (owner: Alex, ETA: 72h).

Maya (eng-sre): I'll add an observability dashboard tile to track safety_score by model-variant + canary (ETA 4h).

Alex (oncall): oncall handoff: I'll hand to Maya at 12:40 UTC for follow-ups. Anyone object?

Maya (eng-sre): taking handoff. Leaving notes in the incident ticket with timeline and commands run.

Alex (oncall): closing the thread here. Thanks all. Postmortem requested — please add logs/traces and a timeline. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident resolved: PD-9072 mitigated -> status: mitigated. Postmortem requested: tag #postmortems and link to Jira INC-4551."
